name: the Man Trap

proprietors.name: John Wellmaker
proprietors.basis: The register matches the printed name to the town card wellmaker_john (action: enrich), so this is the same person the resident layer already holds. Dated by the printing window, which bounds the reading and does not date the partnership.

locations.basis: The register resolved no place for this house at the scene date.
locations.limit_reason: No street the model holds. The anchor "Mr. R. A. Kinzie's Store" names nothing the committed town holds.

dates.basis: No opening is announced. The first printing, 1833-12-10, is the bound: the house was trading by then and the record does not say when it began.

proprietor_community.basis: The 1 keeper(s) this record names and the resident layer holds a card for all read british: John Wellmaker (british). A house is not its keeper, so the reading is an inference about the house and is capped there.

replaceable_by: A directory, a deed or a later reading that names this house's premises, its staff or its dates more exactly than the newspapers do.
